verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents Kubernetes integration for logs/metrics (honeycomb-docs-40) and OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation for hosts/containers/apps (honeycomb-docs-1,2,14,15,30,31), but its own docs show the dedicated Kubernetes agent and Beelines (vendor-specific host/language agents) are being migrated away from in favor of generic OTel SDKs/collectors (honeycomb-docs-41), meaning there's no strong evidence of a broad, actively maintained portfolio of vendor-specific agents across hosts, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud services—OTel is the primary path. Missing for 10: dedicated vendor-maintained host/cloud-service agents (e.g., AWS/GCP/Azure integrations), current (non-deprecated) Kubernetes agent, and independent confirmation of broad agent coverage.
